description: This file defines the TransactionAttribute class, transaction-related enums, and various request and response classes used for managing transactions within Orleans grains. The code facilitates marking methods with transaction semantics, handling transaction lifecycle, and integrating with Orleans' runtime and serialization infrastructure.

classes.name: TransactionAttribute
classes.description: An attribute to mark methods with specific transaction requirements and options.

classes.name: TransactionRequestBase
classes.description: Base class providing common functionality for transaction request handling and execution.

classes.name: TransactionResponse
classes.description: Represents the response of a transaction-related grain call, including transaction info.

classes.name: TransactionRequest
classes.description: Abstract class for transaction request that yields a result of type Response.

classes.name: TransactionRequest<TResult>
classes.description: Abstract class for transaction request that yields a result of type TResult.

classes.name: TransactionTaskRequest<TResult>
classes.description: Abstract class for transaction request that yields a Task<TResult>.

classes.name: TransactionTaskRequest
classes.description: Abstract class for transaction request that yields a Task.

methods.name: TransactionAttribute
methods.description: Constructors and properties to define transaction requirements and options.

methods.name: SetTransactionOptions
methods.description: Sets the transaction option or alias.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Executes the transaction request, managing transaction lifecycle and responses.

methods.name: BaseInvoke
methods.description: Abstract method to implement invocation logic in derived classes.

methods.name: CompleteInvokeAsync
methods.description: Completes an invocation asynchronously, handling exceptions.
